answer: In PoA, reciprocity-weighted interactions form an EigenTrust matrix, while each node’s score undergoes exponential temporal decay, losing half its weight per defined half-life. Honest service must therefore be sustained; a freshly spawned sybil, even inside a colluding nebula, has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming edges. Without a lotus of reciprocal history and an anchor in established peers, its influence cannot reach the threshold required for consensus.
